We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We have applied first three templates, got some precursors. Need to continue with template 149040 then 1914391.

We need to construct a JSON route tree: root molecule (target). Then reaction using template 29646, children are precursors (maybe multiple). Then each precursor may be further broken down using next templates sequentially? The requirement: use templates in this order. Likely a linear sequence: each reaction transforms the molecule to precursors, then next reaction applied to one of those precursors, etc., total 5 steps.

We need to find applicable precursors for each step. We have results from apply_template:

Step1 (template 29646) on target gave three possible precursors (tuples). The result string shows three tuples each containing a SMILES? Actually result: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO',))"

So three possible precursors. Choose one that can be further processed by template 1914389. We applied 1914389 to the first precursor (with Si protecting group) and got two products: a precursor SMILES and another? The result tuple: (('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C', 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC'),). So applying 1914389 gave two fragments (maybe two reactants). So the reaction splits into two molecules: fragment A (still with Si) and fragment B (an ester with phosphonate). Good.

Now we need to apply template 1914390 to something. We tried applying to fragment A (the Si-containing) but got no result. Also tried on fragment B, no result. Maybe template 1914390 should be applied to the product of previous step (maybe the fragment B). But it didn't match. Could be we need to apply 1914390 to a different precursor from step1. Let's try other precursors.

Try applying 1914389 to second precursor from step1: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO".
